chapters.title: The Website
cues: a premium website where customers can explore services,
prices, the gallery, and everything the barbershop offers.
Beautifully designed for both desktop and mobile.

chapters.title: The Owner
cues: the owner has a dedicated dashboard to manage the entire business —
Everything is organized in one place.

chapters.title: The Barber
cues: Every barber has a personal account and dashboard.
They can check their assigned appointments,

chapters.title: The Customer
cues: Customers can create their own account,
select an available date and time,
They can also manage their bookings directly from their phone.
